item.title: HDB Financial Services sees 34% profit jump to ₹780 crore in Q2FY27
item.description: Non-banking financial company HDB Financial Services on Wednesday reported a 34.2 per cent surge in profit after tax to Rs 780 crore in the September quarter of FY27 driven by higher loan demand and lower provisions. The financial services entity had earned a PAT of Rs 581 crore in the year-ago period. Its net interest income rose 15.6 per cent to Rs 2,534 crore in the July-September quarter of FY27, up from Rs 2,192 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year, the firm said in a stock exchange filing. HDB Financial Services' total income rose 12 per cent to Rs 3,188 crore for the quarter under review from Rs 2,851 crore in the year-ago period. Loan losses and provisions declined by 2.5 per cent to Rs 730 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 compared to Rs 748 crore recorded in the same quarter last year. The company registered a 12 per cent growth in gross loan book to Rs 1.24 lakh crore during the quarter under review compared with Rs 1.12 lakh crore
item.bs:keywords: HDB Financial Services, Q2 results, September quarter results, net profit, net interest income, NBFC, loan book, asset quality, assets under management, interim dividend, financial results, lending business

item.title: Tata Trusts row: Noel, son Neville Tata move Mumbai courts with caveats
item.description: Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata and his son Neville have filed caveats in city courts in the row surrounding Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh, sources said on Wednesday. The caveats filed in the Bombay High Court and also in the Mumbai City Civil Court will ensure that they are heard before the passing of any orders. Both the father and son moved the courts with their caveats on October 7, as per official records. Srinivasan and Singh had filed complaints against Noel and Neville Tata with the Maharahstra Charity Commissioner, alleging governance lapses and irregularities at some of the Tata Trusts. Noel and Neville had earlier filed similar caveats at the charity commissioner's office, according to reports. The caveat in the Bombay High Court has Noel as the caveator, while Srinivasan has been named as the caveatee. Singh has been included as an extra party caveatee along with lawyer Darius Khambata and Tata group veteran Bhaskar Bhat. Noel Tata features as the caveator in the move

item.title: BHEL Q2FY27 results: Net profit jumps over two-fold to ₹821 crore
item.description: State-owned BHEL on Wednesday reported a two-fold jump in consolidated net profit to Rs 820.94 crore for the September quarter, driven by higher income from key business verticals such as power and industry. BHEL is India's largest engineering and manufacturing enterprise in the energy and infrastructure sector. The company had clocked a net profit of Rs 374.89 crore in the second quarter of the preceding financial year, BHEL said in an exchange filing. In July-September, the company's total income rose 24 per cent to Rs 9,553.01 crore from Rs 7,686.11 crore in the year-ago period. Sharing segment-wise break-up, the company said that from power and industry businesses, it earned revenue of Rs 6,637.90 crore and Rs 2,662.45 crore, respectively, up from Rs 5,675.64 crore and 1,836.16 crore garnered from the two verticals in the September quarter of FY25. Expenses stood at Rs 8,482.40 crore compared to Rs 7,201.54 crore a year ago.

item.title: Volvo Buses India bags largest-ever order for 200 buses from MSRTC
item.description: Volvo Buses India on Wednesday said it has secured an order from the Maharashtra State Transport Corporation (MSRTC) to supply 200 buses, including 30 sleeper buses. The order is the single-largest for Volvo Buses in India and marks a significant commitment to strengthening premium intercity public transportation in the state, the company said. "This landmark order reflects our shared commitment to elevating travel and making premium passenger experiences more accessible for the citizens of Maharashtra," said Suresh Chettiar, Executive Vice President, Bus Division, VE Commercial Vehicles Ltd. The order comprises 170 seater buses and 30 sleeper buses, the company said. Manufactured at the company's Hoskote facilities, the Volvo 9600 is available in both seater and sleeper configurations, it said.

item.title: Tata Power builds diversified energy pipeline to tap data centre growth
item.description: Tata Power on Wednesday said it is emerging as a preferred partner for India's fast-growing data centre ecosystem, with a diversified opportunity pipeline of over 2.8 GW spanning renewable energy, transmission and distribution opportunities. As demand from AI, cloud and digital platforms accelerates, the company is expanding its role beyond power supply to provide a comprehensive suite of solutions, including powered land, transmission and grid connectivity, renewable energy, storage, cooling and utility infrastructure, enabling the development of hyperscalers and advanced data centre facilities, a company statement said. Tata Power has built a strong and diversified data centre opportunity pipeline, comprising approximately 430 MW of upcoming load under its distribution network, 1,236 MW of transmission-linked opportunities, and 1,150 MW of green energy capacity under active engagement. item.title: Canara Bank Q2 results: Profit rises 8% to ₹5,175 cr, revenue at ₹40,931 cr
item.description: State-owned Canara Bank on Wednesday reported an 8 per cent increase in net profit at Rs 5,175 crore for the September quarter of this fiscal. During the same quarter of the previous financial year, the bank had earned a net profit of Rs 4,774 crore in the year-ago period. Total income increased to Rs 40,931 crore in the second quarter from Rs 38,598 crore in the same period of the previous fiscal year, Canara Bank said in a regulatory filing. Interest income improved to Rs 35,159 crore from Rs 31,544 crore in the same quarter a year ago. Net Interest Income witnessed a 20 per cent jump in the reported quarter to Rs 11,005 crore as against Rs 9,141 crore a year ago. Operating profit also increased to Rs 8,758 crore as against Rs 8,588 crore in the same quarter a year ago.
